title: ZTANPilotMetricsReport
description: Formal telemetry reporting schema for Nexus ZTAN pilot deployments.

pilotId.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise pilot environment.

deploymentEpoch.description: Timestamp when this telemetry snapshot was captured.

softwareRelease.description: The exact software release version of ZTAN core deployed.

reproducibilityRate.description: Rate of deterministic transactional replay reproducibility (target: 1.0).

driftScore.description: Calculated state drift score across nodes (target: 0.0).

activeTenantIsolationEscapes.description: Must be exactly 0. Any horizontal escape triggers immediate hypervisor freeze.

telemetryToRuntimeLocRatio.description: Ratio of telemetry code to total runtime LOC to verify low cognitive complexity.

witnessSignaturesCollected.description: Number of state mutation notarization signatures gathered during epoch.

policyEngineViolationsBlocked.description: Count of unauthorized state transitions intercepted and blocked by the policy agent.

tpmAttestationsSecured.description: Number of successful TPM 2.0 PCR quote signatures validated.

authoritativeLedgerConstraintEnforced.description: Ensures no claim is listed in security/governance docs without claims verification ledger backing.

constitutionRemainsNormative.description: Ensures the constitution contains only normative rules, not implementation/roadmap details.

separationOfAdvisoryAndExecutionEnforced.description: Ensures advisory cognitive components are not in the execution path.
